verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's official docs explicitly state customers can choose to process/store personal data in Europe via the EU Data Residency Program, directly addressing regional data residency choice. This is corroborated by GDPR-related deletion/retrieval API documentation showing broader privacy compliance infrastructure. Missing for 10: no evidence of additional regions beyond EU (e.g., US-only vs other geos), no independent/hands-on confirmation of residency enforcement, and no detail on how residency choice is configured at signup/account level.
